name: Legendary Magic
body:
Prerequisite(s): 22 or more HD, the ability to cast spells, may not be a player character

Benefit(s): Creatures with this feat are capable of magic far greater than that of mere mortals. Their magic is either so expertly crafted or conjured with such raw power that resisting them is nearly impossible. The DCs of spells or spell-like abilities cast by this creature increase by 10.

Legendary Levels: Deific Bestiary. © 2012, Little Red Goblin Games LLC
